set.body: See docs/plans/terminal-workspace.md, V4. Test independent CLI and MCP producers with two viewers, job watch compatibility, no duplicate scheduler collection, observer stop/restart, MFA expiry, laptop observation gaps, disk errors and unknown acceptance. Add headless UI plus real PTY qualification and optional-extra CI. Document complete user/agent journeys and new CLI/MCP contracts. Run repository checks, exact-candidate authorized small live lifecycle, and remote-read-only spies; distinguish local, hosted, live and release evidence. Closing the viewer must never affect job execution.
set.title: V4: qualify and document the two-terminal workspace workflow
